tokens.name: lime
tokens.usage: Brand signal. Fills hero cards, active segments, status chips, the face-pill and CTAs. Always behind `on-lime` text; never used as text on light grounds.

tokens.name: lime-press
tokens.usage: Pressed / hover state of lime fills.

tokens.name: olive
tokens.usage: Shadow layer behind stacked lime cards and the outline chip on lime blocks. Decorative only, never text.

tokens.name: on-lime
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `lime` and `olive` (17:1 on lime).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: The black of the system: primary circle buttons, send button, dark marketing blocks. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Icons and text on `ink` fills.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Primary circle and pill (arrow CTA, send, centre nav button): ink in light, white in dark so it never sinks into dark cards.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Icon and text on `action`.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background on web and app screens.

tokens.name: surface-panel
tokens.usage: Grey photo-hero panels and section blocks behind white cards (the signature grey).

tokens.name: surface-subtle
tokens.usage: Inputs, chips, list-row hovers and the empty part of a meter.

tokens.name: surface-card
tokens.usage: Cards that sit on `surface-panel` or photos.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers inside cards (coverage split, search field separators) and outline buttons.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text on `surface`, `surface-card`, `surface-panel`.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: labels above numbers, dates, meta. ≥4.5:1 on `surface`, `surface-card` and `surface-panel` in both themes.

tokens.name: text-subtle
tokens.usage: Tertiary hints ("Swipe to next", timestamps) on `surface` and `surface-card` only; 3.4:1 on `surface-panel` light, so keep it off grey panels there.

tokens.name: meter-mark
tokens.usage: Barcode stripes and dot grain inside meters. Decorative texture next to a written value.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Approved / in-network dot, always paired with a word.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Badge dot on nav icons and error text; always paired with a word or count.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring on every interactive element (≥3:1 on all surfaces).

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Marketing hero only, max two per page.

styles.name: headline
styles.sample: Your healthcare information is securely stored.
styles.usage: Section headlines on web and stories.

styles.name: title-stack
styles.usage: Provider and clinic names, broken one word per line.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: Prices, ratings and totals. Currency sign at 50% size in `text-muted`.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Section titles inside the app, followed by the squiggle.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Find and book trusted doctors in one place.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Hints under numbers. Never for anything a person must act on.

tokens.name: space-1

tokens.name: space-1.5
tokens.usage: Gap between service tiles and bottom-nav circles.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip padding, gap inside button groups, card stacks on a panel.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between label and value; list rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Inner padding of small cards; bottom-nav offset from the screen edge.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Screen side padding and default card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Photo-caption padding; gap between sections in a card.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between app sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between web sections.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Document thumbnails and map callouts.

tokens.name: radius-md

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Every card and service tile.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets and phone-screen sections.

tokens.name: radius-block
tokens.usage: Marketing blocks and full-bleed bento tiles.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, inputs, segmented tabs, face-pill, circles.
